ambiguities: Hound deep: the rules say you know where the Hound is, but only the swapped case gives you that (simulated that way); if it means always, the game gets much easier
A Ghost still has to be fought to gain its trophy (uses an action); the design notes call it 'a free trophy'
Scavenge can Ready a trick you already used this turn; implemented as still once per turn
Hound lit by a Shove is hunted in the same turn's Phase 3 (implemented as written)
Carry on a Lit card moving into the doorway or next to an empty space relights it; Lighting is derived from positions, so a face-down card can never stay face down there

Strategic outline step 5 'unless you would then have 4+ Ready' and step 6 'leaves 1 Ready' are unclear on counting the new trophy (simulated: step 6 counts Ready after paying wounds, without the new card)

problems.problem: Win rate hinges on solver skill, not on the rules: outline bot wins 19.1%, a lookahead bot 80.8%; the 40-60% band sits in a 60-point gap between them
problems.evidence: Exhaustive 362,880 layouts: outline 19.1%; lookahead (3,632 layouts, every 100th) 80.8%; random 0.0%; greedy 4.9%. Base Claws 3: outline 48.1%, lookahead 98.6%. Base Claws 1: 1.4% / 6.5%. A real player is somewhere between, so the true win rate is unknown
problems.fix: Keep Claws 2 and get 3 or more human sessions before touching numbers; if humans track the outline bot, use Claws 3 with Hunt lethal (untested together) so the strong player is not at 99%

problems.problem: Outline strategic bot misses 4 of the designer's targets (win rate, median length, Feint share, killer spread)
problems.evidence: Median 6 turns (target 7-12); wins using Feint 2.1% (target >=10%); only 3 cards cause over 5% of deaths (Fox 33%, Snake 11%, Hound 55%); the lookahead bot meets Feint 15.7%, Hypnotise 21.1%, neither 63%, median 9 turns, 8.3 min
problems.fix: Treat the lookahead bot as the reference for variety targets; the outline loops (Shoves into the cell that holds the known Hound). A shove-target fix lifts it only to 24.7% in a 3,000-run check

problems.problem: Ghost effect is far outside the 5-25 point target and uneven
problems.evidence: Outline bot, one Ghost: Moth +0.0, Mouse +0.2, Spider +1.4, Rat +21, Hound +19, Snake +29, Crow +38, Fox +43, Owl +44 points. Ghost Moth/Mouse/Spider are nearly pointless; Ghost Owl/Fox/Crow nearly double the win rate
problems.fix: Give low-card Ghosts a real effect (for example the Ghost grants a Ready trophy at setup) and cap the Owl/Fox/Crow Ghosts (Ghost Danger 2 rather than 0)

problems.problem: Three tricks are close to dead and Carry is never tested by a strong bot
problems.evidence: Strong-bot trick use when Ready: Moth 0.5%, Spider 0.3%, Crow 0 (not modelled); outline: Crow 0.15%. Target is 15%. Mouse 82%, Rat 86%, Snake 98%, Fox 100% in strong play
problems.fix: Make Glow free of the Ready cost or let Silk also protect the Hound shove; rework Carry (swap plus a free Fight discount) and test it with a bot that models Carry

problems.problem: Opening is a grind of Shoves in about 36% of layouts and the doorway can leave no safe Fight
problems.evidence: Strategic bot's first action is a Shove in 35.7% of layouts (inside 20-60%) but the lookahead bot opens with a Shove in 90.9%; narrated play: three Shoves before the first Fight
problems.fix: Consider a free Peek at one Dark card at setup, or start with 1 Ready trophy

problems.problem: Run length for a competent player is below the 10-minute target
problems.evidence: Lookahead: mean 8.4 turns, 8.3 min (target 10, -17%, inside the +/-20% band); outline 6.4 min. Longest run 14 turns, no turn-cap hits in 700k runs
problems.fix: None needed unless human sessions run short; tally time and deliberation are not modelled

experiments_note: Lookahead on 1,210 layouts (every 300th); outline exhaustive. Baseline: 0.191 / 0.808.
card_win_correlation_caveat: Trick win links are confounded: tricks get used when the cat is in trouble (Spider -0.59), so they read as negative.
